Hi Ben,

We came across Redwood Inference on the AWS Marketplace and I wanted to reach out about a short intro + demo for our platform team. We're evaluating inference platforms to replace a mix of self-hosted endpoints and a managed offering — primary interest is predictable latency and lower serving cost.

Would love a 30-45 minute intro/demo covering:
- Typical deployment options (hosted vs dedicated vs private)
- Performance/latency profiles for 1k–5k qps workloads
- Cost levers (batching, quantization) and SLA guidance

We're based in PST. Current availability: Tue/Wed afternoons this week (Jan 13–14) between 1pm–4pm PT. Attendees will include myself (platform owner) and Sarah L. (infra lead).

Thanks — happy to share a short requirements note if helpful.

Best,

AcmeCloud
